## Boundaries and dependencies

- [ ] Examples, tests, fixtures, logs, and screenshots contain only synthetic or
      already-public content.
- [ ] No proprietary lore, unpublished canon, secrets, personal data, or private
      production context is included.
- [ ] Any cross-repository contract change is proposed in or versioned by
      `codex`; this PR does not silently redefine it.
- [ ] Documentation and operational guidance are updated where applicable.
- [ ] Agent/workflow changes document delegated authority, external policy
      enforcement, audit evidence, failure recovery, and human takeover.
- [ ] Release-affecting changes identify the exact candidate, gates, approvals,
      provenance, rollback, and published-byte verification.
